mapper.insert: INSERT INTO his_zj_sj.pending SELECT * FROM pending WHERE pending_code IN ( SELECT t1.pending_code FROM ( SELECT p.pending_code FROM pending p WHERE p.response_msg = '100-操作成功' AND p.operator_type = 'a' ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT p.pending_code FROM pending p WHERE p.response_msg = '100-操作成功' AND p.operator_type = 'u' ) t2 ON t1.pending_code = t2.pending_code )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pending WHERE pending_code IN ( SELECT t1.pending_code FROM ( SELECT p.pending_code FROM pending p WHERE p.response_msg = '100-操作成功' AND p.operator_type = 'a' ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT p.pending_code FROM pending p WHERE p.response_msg = '100-操作成功' AND p.operator_type = 'u' ) t2 ON t1.pending_code = t2.pending_code )
